title: Smoky Pork Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with smoky pork and fujian noodles. Serve hot and enjoy!
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped nutty and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the fujian noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
